placements.title: Branch library service schedules and staffing allocations
placements.frame: what operational policies, patron access schedules, and resource constraints govern branch library management?

placements.title: Balancing early commuter access with reciprocal early closing offsets to maintain flat staffing
placements.frame: How should branch library operating hours adjust to capture commuter traffic while preserving flat staffing baselines?
placements.why: Both expressions establish a coupled operational policy: opening early at 8 a.m. on Tuesdays and Thursdays specifically for commuters while offsetting the schedule with an hour-earlier closure to avoid staffing increases.
